title: Process Tasks Using Servers
goal: Assign arriving tasks to servers using weight and index priority while preserving task order.
strategy: Track each server next-free time. Process tasks in arrival order, waiting for the first completion if necessary, then choose the lowest-weight available server and smallest index.
